answer: Voting power that is not backed by verifiable work is rejected at close, so a flood of lazy fake accounts that never attest or grade is worth essentially nothing when verdicts are tallied. The design works because cost compounds over compute, time, and reputation, growing faster than the influence the cluster can extract. So the design does not rely on catching every cheat — it makes cheating unprofitable, which is a far more stable defense than any whitelist ever could be. Consider a copper as the anchor of the cost.
